freeze_rule: Commit before site-model evaluations, target-date formal-error extraction or residuals. Source and implementation inspection precede freeze. No tuning, fitted bias or residual exclusions.
scope: Independent leading-order site-clock mapping experiment and uncertainty qualification audit. Explicitly retain incomplete physical qualification; no production or combined arrival converter.

model.D: DE440t geocentric TT-TDB in seconds, raw CSPICE time segment
model.velocity: DE440t geometric Earth barycentric velocity, CSPICE spkez 399 relative to 0, J2000, NONE; km/s converted to m/s
model.position: Skyfield WGS84 position rotated from ITRS to GCRS, meters; TT epoch, frozen UT1 and polar motion; model precession/nutation without observed dX,dY
model.tdb_argument: Inject iterated integrated delta into Skyfield tdb_fraction; patch its approximate tdb_minus_tt to raise, preventing hidden fallback
model.caveat: GCRS station position is a deliberately leading-order surrogate, not the exact scaled BCRS station difference. No proof of full frame/scale mapping or c^-4 remainder is claimed.
model.no_replacement: This separately versioned research model does not replace the selected Astropy/ERFA site clock; no extra Einstein term is added to the candidate.

design.selection: All four historical dates x four sites x three hours from Mission 38. Twelve separate zero-site controls. No direction-based multiplication.
design.retain: All signed comparisons, iterations, supplied vectors, reader differences and failures; UTC-for-UT1 and no-polar-motion variants are component diagnostics only.
design.candidate: Live Astropy site/geocentre clocks with frozen tables, plus Mission 41 archival reproduction check
design.threshold_meaning: Engineering reproduction/algebra checks only; no candidate-versus-surrogate physical accuracy threshold

eop_evidence.distribution: astropy-iers-data 0.2026.9.21.0.56.25, original ASCII file as data only
eop_evidence.extract: Eight UTC-midnight records bracketing the four historical dates; retain xp,yp,UT1-UTC,dX,dY and their five formal errors; parse original ASCII without Astropy
eop_evidence.usage: Nominal mapping retains prior frozen EOP means. Formal errors are evidence, not hard bounds. No covariance, coverage probability, missing CIP correction or interpolation error is invented.

conditional_sensitivity_example.vector_bound_formula: (V*delta_r + R*delta_v + delta_v*delta_r)/c^2, triangle inequality, no independence assumption
conditional_sensitivity_example.c4_station_envelope_formula: (3*U + V^2/2)*V*R/c^4, only the displayed Park equation 3 station term under compatible-coordinate bounds
conditional_sensitivity_example.not_total: Neither example includes geocentric ephemeris error, full frame/scale conversion, higher orders, EOP interpolation/model errors or actual station/clock errors. Never sum it as a complete physical bound.

sources.role: Section 2.3 equation 3, site terms and normalization; no borrowed complete uncertainty bound
Equations 10.1-10.5 and time-ephemeris convention caveats; published TE405/FB estimates do not automatically transfer to DE440t
Klioner 2008: distinct scaled coordinate quantities, not different SI units
Independent orientation implementation and explicit polar-motion input
Original C04 field definitions and formal errors; the pinned original file, not latest data, is used
